answer: The trellis keeps one record per maker, and money carries the count: a wallet funded from a tallied wallet inherits its tally, so fresh wallets never restart it. A head's kernel must sign every epoch or the head goes hollow, and hollow heads still count. Buying the k-th head burns coin equal to all the maker burned on earlier heads: an honest newcomer burns 1 coin, one operator's thousandth head burns 2^999 coins.
